items.title: Jillean Williams interviewed by Milt Fillius and Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 20, 1995
items.q: he’s got Marlena Shaw on some of them too, and she is a knockout.

ctx.x: I love some of it, yes. You know that Gospel stuff, you can hardly keep still, and he’s got Marlena Shaw on some of them too, and she is a knockout. So it’s really fun and he loves it. And he’s giving the proceeds to a scholarship fund I think.
